sehemu: Part III: Procedure, Powers and Privileges of Parliament
maudhui: (1) There shall be a Clerk of the National Assembly who shall be appointed by the President from among persons holding senior office in the service of the Government of the United Republic. (2) The Clerk of the National Assembly shall be the chief executive in the Office of the National Assembly and shall be responsible for the efficient conduct of the business of Parliament in accordance with this Constitution and the relevant law.
